description: Fictional IAM security policies used for SIRVT backup and recovery testing.

policies.requirement: Multi-factor authentication is required for privileged and management access.
Workers should only receive access required for their assigned duties.
Accounts belonging to workers who leave Sunhaven Care must be disabled promptly.
Temporary agency access must not remain active after the approved work period ends.
User access should be reviewed regularly to confirm that it is still required.
